column1: # area: arena — addresses named while working through docs/issues/arena-desync.md. Only addresses no other file names.

column3: handler of game message id 0: increments g_cutVoiceDoneCount; registered by cut_registerNetMsg
per-object callback of cut_setup, first walk: a creature with inert bit 8 is linked back into the grid and gets inert bit 2, so the actor box query can find it
per-object callback of cut_setup, second walk (call 0x19b3a4): a creature with inert bit 8 goes back off the grid and loses inert bit 2

per-object callback of cut_setup when header flag 8 is set (call 0x19b3c0): a creature whose inert byte +0x231 is 0 gets inert bit 4, object flags 0x88000 and is moved off the grid; players are not excluded
per-object callback of cut_end when header flag 8 is set (call 0x19a554): a creature whose inert byte is exactly 4 gets it cleared, loses flags 0x88000 and is re-linked to the grid
stores 0 at 0x8e4560; only caller is Skelight_setState case 0x14 (was Skelight_clearStatic8e4560)
returns the word at 0x4fdcc0 while dialog_isOpen(), else 0; gameSetObjectVis uses a non-zero result as the only activity centre
s32 read by Creature_spawnScavenger after its g_randSeed draw: 1 and 2 select which Critter is built, anything else none; zeroed by objects_levelReset, written by levelSettings_parse
byte: cut_runFrame calls cut_setup once while it is 0; cleared by cut_start
null-terminated property list (one name= entry) handed to the Skelight a non-player caster summons; the four lists before it (0x503750, 8 bytes each) are for player slots 0-3
five name pointers: player slots 0-3, then the non-player name at 0x503788 that SkillSummonSkeleton_canUse looks up
